name: fbiommucycle
purpose: one boot: HW mode 3 with IOMMU 0 (pool only), 1 (dry run), 2 (single-layer IOVA + scattered colour test), 3 (all layers), 0 again; probe dump at start and after every phase
config: modes=3,3,3,3,3 iommu=0,1,2,3,0 probe=1 iotest=1 hwtest=6 period=120 delay=90 pool=1 final=0
needs: a kernel with 0401 (kern.n2fbiommu*) on 0394..0400 -- e.g. q10jfj + 0401; without 0401 the iommu lines log rc=2 and the fbhw schedule still runs
